units.locator: Article 27.19. Placement in special institutions of foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation
units.text: 3.9. At a court hearing, the motion shall be considered with the participation of the foreign citizen or stateless person subject to compulsory expulsion, their legal representatives and/or defence counsel, and the person who submitted the motion, if the judge declares those persons’ presence at the hearing mandatory.
units.label: Part 3.9 Art. 27.19

units.locator: Article 27.19. Placement in special institutions of foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation
units.text: 3.10. Failure to appear at the court hearing by the duly notified authorised official of the internal affairs body or executive body responsible for security who submitted the motion shall not prevent its consideration and resolution where documents confirming the circumstances stated in the motion are available.
units.label: Part 3.10 Art. 27.19

units.locator: Article 27.19. Placement in special institutions of foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation
units.text: 3.11. A copy of the judge’s order referred to in part 3.7 of this Article shall be handed against a signed receipt to the person in respect of whom it was issued (their legal representative), or sent to that person by registered mail on the day it is issued. A copy of the judge’s order referred to in part 3.7 of this Article shall also be sent on that day to the authorised official of the internal affairs body or executive body responsible for security who submitted the motion to extend the period of stay.
units.label: Part 3.11 Art. 27.19

units.locator: Article 27.19. Placement in special institutions of foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation
units.text: 3.12. The judge’s decision following consideration of the motion to extend the period for holding a foreign citizen or stateless person in a special institution may be appealed under the rules established by Chapter 30 of this Code.
units.label: Part 3.12 Art. 27.19

units.locator: Article 27.19. Placement in special institutions of foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation
units.text: 3.13. Further extension of the period for holding a foreign citizen or stateless person subject to compulsory expulsion from the Russian Federation in a special institution shall be carried out under Article 27.19.1 of this Code.
units.label: Part 3.13 Art. 27.19

units.locator: Article 27.19. Placement in special institutions of foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation
units.text: 4. A foreign citizen or stateless person who has committed an administrative offence concerning protection of the State Border of the Russian Federation shall be placed in specially designated premises of a border authority on the basis of a judge’s ruling or a decision of the relevant border authority official.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 27.19

units.locator: Article 27.19.1. Periods for holding foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in special institutions
units.text: Article 27.19.1. Periods for holding foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in special institutions
units.label: Art. 27.19.1

units.locator: Article 27.19.1. Periods for holding foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in special institutions
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 27.19.1. Periods for holding foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in special institutions
units.label: Art. 27.19.1

units.locator: Article 27.19.1. Periods for holding foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in special institutions
units.text: 1. The period for holding a foreign citizen or stateless person subject to compulsory expulsion from the Russian Federation in a special institution provided for by Federal Law of 25 July 2002 No. 115-FZ “On the Legal Status of Foreign Citizens in the Russian Federation” shall not exceed ninety days, except where extended under part 2 of this Article.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 27.19.1

units.locator: Article 27.19.1. Periods for holding foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in special institutions
units.text: 2. If there is no practical possibility of enforcing the ruling imposing administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation on a foreign citizen or stateless person within the period specified in part 1 of this Article, a judge may, upon a motion by the enforcement bailiff executing the ruling in the administrative offence case or an authorised internal affairs official, extend the period for holding that person in a special institution by no more than ninety days.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 27.19.1

units.locator: Article 27.19.1. Periods for holding foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in special institutions
units.text: 3. A motion to extend the period for holding a foreign citizen or stateless person subject to compulsory expulsion in a special institution shall be submitted to the court at the institution’s location no later than fifteen days before expiry of the period established by the judge’s ruling referred to in part 3 of Article 27.19 of this Code. It shall state why extension is necessary and the period by which the stay should be extended.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 27.19.1

units.locator: Article 27.19.1. Periods for holding foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in special institutions
units.text: 4. The motion shall be accompanied by documents confirming the circumstances stated in it. If the person subject to administrative expulsion has no identity document, the motion shall be accompanied by an internal affairs body’s identity-establishment report prepared under federal law.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 27.19.1

units.locator: Article 27.19.1. Periods for holding foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in special institutions
units.text: 5. Within one day from receiving the motion, the judge shall issue a procedural order setting its time and place of consideration and extending the persons’ stay in the special institution for the time necessary to consider it.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 27.19.1

units.locator: Article 27.19.1. Periods for holding foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in special institutions
units.text: 6. The motion shall be considered by a judge within five days from receipt.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 27.19.1

units.locator: Article 27.19.1. Periods for holding foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in special institutions
units.text: 7. In preparation for considering the motion, matters shall be resolved on which, where necessary, one of the following procedural orders shall be issued:
units.label: Part 7 Art. 27.19.1

units.locator: Article 27.19.1. Periods for holding foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in special institutions
units.text: 1) summoning the foreign citizen or stateless person subject to compulsory expulsion in respect of whom the motion to extend their stay in the special institution has been submitted;
units.label: Point 1 Part 7 Art. 27.19.1

units.locator: Article 27.19.1. Periods for holding foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in special institutions
units.text: 2) summoning the person who submitted to the court the motion to extend the period for holding the foreign citizen or stateless person subject to compulsory expulsion in the special institution, whether the enforcement bailiff executing the ruling in the administrative offence case or the authorised internal affairs official;
units.label: Point 2 Part 7 Art. 27.19.1

units.locator: Article 27.19.1. Periods for holding foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in special institutions
units.text: 3) requisitioning, under Article 26.10 of this Code, materials (information) necessary to ensure proper and timely consideration and resolution of the question of extending the stay of the foreign citizen or stateless person subject to compulsory expulsion in the special institution.
units.label: Point 3 Part 7 Art. 27.19.1

units.locator: Article 27.19.1. Periods for holding foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in special institutions
units.text: 8. Following consideration of the motion, the judge shall issue a procedural order specifying one of the following decisions:
units.label: Part 8 Art. 27.19.1

units.locator: Article 27.19.1. Periods for holding foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in special institutions
units.text: 1) to extend the period for holding the foreign citizen or stateless person subject to administrative expulsion in the special institution;
units.label: Point 1 Part 8 Art. 27.19.1

units.locator: Article 27.19.1. Periods for holding foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in special institutions
units.text: 2) to refuse the motion.
units.label: Point 2 Part 8 Art. 27.19.1

units.locator: Article 27.19.1. Periods for holding foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in special institutions
units.text: 9. The judge’s decision extending the period for holding a foreign citizen or stateless person subject to compulsory expulsion in a special institution shall take the form of a procedural order specifying the particular period of stay, not exceeding ninety days.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 27.19.1

units.locator: Article 27.19.1. Periods for holding foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in special institutions
units.text: 10. At a court hearing, the motion shall be considered with the participation of the foreign citizen or stateless person subject to compulsory expulsion, their legal representatives and/or defence counsel, and the person who submitted the motion, if the judge declares those persons’ presence at the hearing mandatory.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 27.19.1

units.locator: Article 27.19.1. Periods for holding foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in special institutions
units.text: 11. Failure to appear at the court hearing by the authorised internal affairs official who submitted the motion or by the enforcement bailiff executing the ruling in the administrative offence case, provided that the person failing to appear has been duly notified, shall not prevent consideration and resolution of the motion where documents confirming the circumstances stated in it are available.
units.label: Part 11 Art. 27.19.1

units.locator: Article 27.19.1. Periods for holding foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in special institutions
units.text: 12. A copy of the judge’s order extending the stay shall be handed against a signed receipt to the person in respect of whom it was issued (their legal representative), or sent to those persons by registered mail or electronically, including in the form of an electronic document, under the procedure and in the cases provided for by Article 24.9 of this Code, on the day the order is issued.
units.label: Part 12 Art. 27.19.1

units.locator: Article 27.19.1. Periods for holding foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in special institutions
units.text: 13. A copy of the judge’s order extending the stay shall be sent on the day it is issued to the enforcement bailiff and authorised internal affairs official who submitted the relevant motion.
units.label: Part 13 Art. 27.19.1

units.locator: Article 27.19.1. Periods for holding foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in special institutions
units.text: 14. The judge’s decision following consideration of the motion to extend the period for holding a foreign citizen or stateless person subject to administrative expulsion in a special institution may be appealed under the rules established by Chapter 30 of this Code.
units.label: Part 14 Art. 27.19.1

units.locator: Article 27.19.1. Periods for holding foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in special institutions
units.text: 15. Further extension of the period for holding a foreign citizen or stateless person subject to compulsory expulsion in a special institution shall be carried out under this Article.
units.label: Part 15 Art. 27.19.1

units.locator: Article 27.19.1. Periods for holding foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in special institutions
units.text: 16. The period for holding a foreign citizen or stateless person subject to compulsory expulsion in a special institution shall run from the day the administrative expulsion ruling is issued, or, where the stay is extended, from the day the judge issues the procedural order extending it.
units.label: Part 16 Art. 27.19.1

units.locator: Article 27.19.1. Periods for holding foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in special institutions
units.text: 17. Before compulsory expulsion from the Russian Federation, a foreign citizen or stateless person placed in a special institution as a measure securing proceedings for the purpose of compulsory expulsion may, where circumstances indicate that there is no practical possibility of expulsion, but no earlier than one month after the ruling imposing that penalty enters into legal force under this Code, apply to a court to review the lawfulness and justification of continued detention in the special institution.
units.label: Part 17 Art. 27.19.1

units.locator: Article 27.19.1. Periods for holding foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in special institutions
units.text: 18. The motion shall be submitted to the court at the location of the special institution where the foreign citizen or stateless person is held and considered by a judge within five days from receipt. The judge shall issue a procedural order granting the motion and terminating the person’s detention in the special institution or refusing the motion.
units.label: Part 18 Art. 27.19.1

units.locator: Article 27.20. Attachment of property to secure enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: Article 27.20. Attachment of property to secure enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.label: Art. 27.20

units.locator: Article 27.20. Attachment of property to secure enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 27.20. Attachment of property to secure enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.label: Art. 27.20

units.locator: Article 27.20. Attachment of property to secure enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: 1. To secure enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty for an offence under Article 15.27.3 or 19.28 of this Code, or for an offence committed outside the Russian Federation under Article 13.14.1 or 13.15, part 2 of Article 13.36, part 2 of Article 13.37, Article 13.48, 17.13 or 19.34, part 3, 4 or 5 of Article 20.1, or Article 20.3.1, 20.3.2, 20.3.3, 20.3.4, 20.29 or 20.33 of this Code, or an offence consisting in failure to pay within the period specified by this Code an administrative fine imposed for an offence under Article 13.14.1, 13.15, 13.36, 13.37, 13.48, 17.13 or 19.34, part 3, 4 or 5 of Article 20.1, or Article 20.3.1, 20.3.2, 20.3.3, 20.3.4, 20.29 or 20.33 of this Code, attachment shall be applied to property of the person against whom proceedings in the relevant case are conducted.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 27.20

units.locator: Article 27.20. Attachment of property to secure enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: 2. The value of property attached to secure enforcement of a penalty ruling for an offence under Article 15.27.3 or 19.28 of this Code shall not exceed the maximum administrative fine for an offence under Article 15.27.3 or the relevant part of Article 19.28 of this Code. For another offence referred to in part 1 of this Article, the value of property attached shall not be limited by the administrative fine prescribed for that offence.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 27.20

units.locator: Article 27.20. Attachment of property to secure enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: 3. Attachment consists in prohibiting the person against whom proceedings are conducted for an offence referred to in part 1 of this Article from disposing of the attached property and, where necessary, imposing restrictions on possession and use of it.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 27.20

units.locator: Article 27.20. Attachment of property to secure enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: 4. To secure enforcement of a penalty ruling for an offence under Article 15.27.3 or 19.28 of this Code, money in deposits and accounts at banks or other credit institutions shall be attached where the legal entity has no other property. For another offence referred to in part 1 of this Article, money in deposits and accounts at banks or other credit institutions shall be attached, and other property shall be attached if the person has no such money.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 27.20

units.locator: Article 27.20. Attachment of property to secure enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: 5. The judge handling a case concerning an offence referred to in part 1 of this Article shall decide on attachment on the basis of a reasoned motion from the prosecutor or person authorised to initiate such a case, received together with the ruling initiating the case or the administrative offence record. The judge shall specify the particular factual circumstances supporting the decision and impose restrictions on disposal of the attached property and, where necessary, on possession and use of it.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 27.20

units.locator: Article 27.20. Attachment of property to secure enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: 6. Where an administrative investigation is conducted, the prosecutor or person authorised to initiate a case concerning an offence referred to in part 1 of this Article may submit an attachment motion to the court simultaneously with issuing, under part 2 of Article 28.7 of this Code, the ruling initiating the case and conducting an administrative investigation.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 27.20

units.locator: Article 27.20. Attachment of property to secure enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: 7. The motion from the prosecutor or person authorised to initiate a case concerning an offence referred to in part 1 of this Article, provided for by parts 5 and 6 of this Article, shall be considered by a judge no later than the day following its receipt by the court, without notifying the prosecutor or authorised person or the person against whom proceedings are conducted.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 27.20

units.locator: Article 27.20. Attachment of property to secure enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: 8. The judge’s decision granting or refusing an attachment motion from the prosecutor or person authorised to initiate a case concerning an offence referred to in part 1 of this Article shall take the form of a procedural order, which may be appealed under the rules established by Chapter 30 of this Code.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 27.20

units.locator: Article 27.20. Attachment of property to secure enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: 9. If the judge issues an attachment order, a copy shall immediately be sent to the prosecutor or person authorised to initiate a case concerning an offence referred to in part 1 of this Article, the enforcement bailiff, the person against whom proceedings are conducted, their defence counsel and/or legal representative, and, where necessary, state bodies registering property or rights to it. If the judge refuses attachment, a copy of that order shall immediately be sent to the prosecutor or person authorised to initiate the relevant administrative offence case.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 27.20

units.locator: Article 27.20. Attachment of property to secure enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: 10. An attachment order constitutes an enforcement document and shall be enforced under legislation on enforcement proceedings.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 27.20

units.locator: Article 27.20. Attachment of property to secure enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: 11. The judge who issued the attachment order may lift attachment upon a motion from the prosecutor or person authorised to initiate a case concerning an offence referred to in part 1 of this Article, an enforcement bailiff, or upon a reasoned application from the person whose property is subject to that measure securing proceedings, their defence counsel and/or legal representative.
units.label: Part 11 Art. 27.20

units.locator: Article 27.20. Attachment of property to secure enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: 12. Deferral or payment by instalments of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty shall not constitute grounds for lifting attachment of property, including money.
units.label: Part 12 Art. 27.20

units.locator: Article 27.20. Attachment of property to secure enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: 13. The motions and applications referred to in part 11 of this Article shall be considered by a judge within five days from receipt, with notification of the prosecutor or person authorised to initiate a case concerning an offence referred to in part 1 of this Article, the enforcement bailiff, the person whose property is attached, their defence counsel and/or legal representative.
units.label: Part 13 Art. 27.20

units.locator: Article 27.20. Attachment of property to secure enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: 14. The judge’s decision granting or refusing a motion or application referred to in part 11 of this Article shall take the form of a procedural order, which may be appealed under the rules established by Chapter 30 of this Code.
units.label: Part 14 Art. 27.20

units.locator: Article 27.20. Attachment of property to secure enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
units.text: 15. If the judge issues a order lifting attachment, a copy shall immediately be sent to the prosecutor or person authorised to initiate a case concerning an offence referred to in part 1 of this Article, the enforcement bailiff, the person whose property was subject to that measure securing proceedings, their defence counsel and/or legal representative, and, where necessary, state bodies registering property or rights to it.
units.label: Part 15 Art. 27.20

units.text: Chapter 28. Initiation of an administrative offence case

units.locator: Chapter 28. Initiation of an administrative offence case
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Chapter 28. INITIATION OF AN ADMINISTRATIVE OFFENCE CASE
units.label: Chapter 28. Initiation of an administrative offence case · “Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation.…”

units.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case
units.text: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 28.1

units.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 28.1

units.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case
units.text: 1. The reasons for initiating an administrative offence case are:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 28.1

units.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case
units.text: 1) direct discovery by officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records of sufficient data indicating that an administrative offence has occurred;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 28.1

units.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case
units.text: 2) materials received from law enforcement bodies, and from other state bodies, local self-government bodies or public associations, containing data indicating that an administrative offence has occurred;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 28.1

units.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case
units.text: 3) reports and applications from individuals and legal entities, and reports in the mass media, containing data indicating that an administrative offence has occurred (except for the administrative offences provided for by part 2 of Article 5.27 and Article 14.52 of this Code);
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 28.1

units.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case
units.text: 4) recording, by automatically operating special technical devices with photographic, motion-picture or video recording functions, or by photographic, motion-picture or video recording equipment, of an administrative offence in the sphere of environmental protection and use of natural resources (as regards the administrative offences provided for by parts 3.1 - 3.4 of Article 8.2 of this Code), in the sphere of road traffic, or an administrative offence in the sphere of territorial improvement or an administrative offence consisting in failure to comply with the procedure for paying for vehicle travel on toll public roads of regional, intermunicipal or local significance, private public roads, toll sections of public roads of regional, intermunicipal or local significance or private public roads, provided for by a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, committed using a vehicle or by the owner or other holder of a land plot or another immovable property, and recording, using the monitoring information system, of an administrative offence provided for by part 6, 7 or 8 of Article 14.3.1, part 4, 5 or 6 of Article 14.6, part 4 of Article 14.43 or Article 15.12.2 of this Code;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 28.1

units.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case
units.text: 5) confirmation of data contained in a report or application by the owner (holder) of a vehicle that, in the cases provided for by point 4 of this part, the vehicle was in the possession or use of another person.
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 28.1

units.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case
units.text: 1.1. The reasons for initiating cases concerning the administrative offences provided for by Articles 14.12, 14.13 and 14.23 of this Code are the reasons specified in points 1, 2 and 3 of part 1 of this Article, as well as applications by persons participating in a bankruptcy case and persons participating in commercial-court proceedings in a bankruptcy case, the management bodies of a debtor that is a legal entity, or a self-regulatory organisation of insolvency administrators, containing sufficient data indicating that an administrative offence has occurred.
units.label: Part 1.1 Art. 28.1

units.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case
units.text: 1.2. The reason for initiating cases concerning the administrative offences provided for by Articles 14.9, 14.31, 14.32, 14.33 and 14.40 of this Code is the adoption by a commission of the antimonopoly authority of a decision establishing a violation of the antimonopoly legislation of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 1.2 Art. 28.1

units.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case
units.text: 1.2-1. The reason for initiating cases concerning the administrative offences provided for by Article 14.9.1 of this Code is the adoption by a commission of the antimonopoly authority of a decision establishing a violation of the procedure for carrying out measures in the implementation of a construction project by a federal executive authority, a state authority of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, a local self-government body, another body or organisation performing the functions of those bodies, or an organisation participating in the provision of state or municipal services.
units.label: Part 1.2-1 Art. 28.1

units.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case
units.text: 1.2-2. The reason for initiating cases concerning the administrative offences provided for by parts 8 and 9 of Article 7.30.3 of this Code is the adoption by a commission of the federal executive authority exercising state control (supervision) functions in the sphere of the state defence order of a decision establishing a violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation in the sphere of the state defence order.
units.label: Part 1.2-2 Art. 28.1

units.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case
units.text: 1.2-3. The reason for initiating cases concerning the administrative offences provided for by parts 3 and 15 of Article 7.30.3 of this Code is failure to comply within the prescribed period with a demand of the federal executive authority exercising state control (supervision) functions in the sphere of the state defence order to cease actions (inaction) containing indications of a violation of legislation in the sphere of the state defence order.
units.label: Part 1.2-3 Art. 28.1

units.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case
units.text: 1.3. The reason for initiating cases concerning the administrative offences provided for by Articles 8.35 and 8.37 of this Code is a report on the presence of indications of an administrative offence or crime connected with violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation in the sphere of hunting and conservation of hunting resources, drawn up by an in-house hunting inspector in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 1.3 Art. 28.1
